description: Early humans begin using fire for warmth and cooking

impact: Created one of history's greatest empires

impact: Period of economic and cultural decline in Europe

description: A cultural and artistic movement begins in Italy
impact: Revival of classical learning and humanism

description: Columbus sails across the Atlantic Ocean
impact: Led to European exploration of the Americas

description: Transition from agricultural to industrial economy begins in Britain
United States declares independence from British rule
impact: Birth of democratic nation in North America

description: Revolution overthrows French monarchy and feudalism
impact: Spread ideals of liberty, equality, and democracy

description: Samuel Morse sends first telegraph message
impact: First form of instant long-distance communication

impact: Led to new countries and changed international politics

description: Apollo 11 astronauts land on the Moon

description: Advanced AI chatbots become widely accessible
